name: prompt-optimization-agent
description: Audit, restructure, compare, and statically validate prompts with explicit intent preservation and decision gates.

interface.shortDescription: Audits and optimizes prompts without silent intent changes.
interface.longDescription: A cross-domain Prompt Optimization Agent for Codex. It extracts an evidenced task specification, audits ambiguity and conflicts, exposes material decisions, compiles concise prompt candidates, and reports the strength and limits of validation.
defaultPrompt: Audit and optimize this prompt without silently changing its intent.
Compare these two prompts and identify unresolved decision branches.
Statically validate this prompt and state what remains unverified.
